Bid Summary.value: The Dallas Independent School District (Dallas ISD) is soliciting proposals under RFP JA-207652 (SOURCING #168884) for student and staff computing devices including laptops, desktops, tablets, monitors, and related accessories, with an anticipated contract term of three years plus two optional one-year renewals, totaling up to five years. The procurement is bond-funded and quantities are estimated over the contract life with flexible purchase volume and delivery starting September 2024, requiring vendors to provide white glove services including asset decaling, etching, and deployment coordination with Dallas ISD ED TECH. The award approach allows for single or multiple vendors on a line-item basis, with evaluation weighted on purchase price (40 points), vendor reputation (10 points), quality (15 points), district needs fit (15 points), MWBE participation (20 points), and other relevant factors, culminating in a best value award anticipated by August 2024 Board meeting. Addendum 1 clarified warranty terms requiring OEM-backed warranties of one year for student Chromebooks and three years for Windows laptops and staff devices, confirmed funding sources, delivery and deployment details, and submission requirements. Addendum 2 extended the proposal due date to July 9, 2024, 2:00 PM CST, without other changes. Vendors must acknowledge all addenda upon proposal submission.
